reviewCandidates.subject: [M157] views: Defer MenuRunnerImpl destruction in OnMenuClosed
reviewCandidates.message:
[M157] views: Defer MenuRunnerImpl destruction in OnMenuClosed

MenuRunnerImpl::OnMenuClosed cleared `controller_` before invoking
ExecuteCommand and OnMenuClosed on the MenuDelegate. When a delegate
reset its MenuRunner inside those callbacks while MenuController frames
were active on the stack, MenuRunnerImpl::Release saw a null
`controller_` and deleted `this` synchronously instead of calling
DeferMenuRunnerDestruction, causing a UAF on MenuItemView.

Keep the `controller_` WeakPtr across OnMenuClosed and invalidate
`weak_factory_` when deferring destruction in Release.

(cherry picked from commit 041491e936ea6063e528de24b9d540015960a5c1)

reviewCandidates.subject: [M157] Harden PersistentSystemProfile against corrupt segment sizes
reviewCandidates.message:
[M157] Harden PersistentSystemProfile against corrupt segment sizes

Original change's description:
> Harden PersistentSystemProfile against corrupt segment sizes
>
> PersistentSystemProfile::RecordAllocator assumes that adopted
> system profile segments have a positive size aligned to the 4-byte
> RecordHeader boundary. If a corrupted or crafted persistent memory
> file contains a block whose size is not aligned, the remaining
> room calculation in WriteData() can underflow, resulting in an
> out-of-bounds write past the end of the segment.
>
> To prevent this:
> 1. Validate in PersistentMemoryAllocator::GetBlock() that allocated
>    blocks have a non-empty payload size aligned to kAllocAlignment.
> 2. Preserve the last valid segment reference in NextSegment() when
>    iteration reaches the end so failed allocations do not wrap
>    around to the first segment.
> 3. Verify the cached segment size in GetAsArray() calls and reset
>    pre-existing segments when constructing a writer RecordAllocator.
>

reviewCandidates.subject: [M157] [FSA] Prevent synchronous lock promotion UAF during manager teardown
reviewCandidates.message:
[M157] [FSA] Prevent synchronous lock promotion UAF during manager teardown

Original change's description:
> [FSA] Prevent synchronous lock promotion UAF during manager teardown
>
> During ~FileSystemAccessManagerImpl(), destroying
> `access_handle_host_receivers_` and `writer_receivers_` before
> `file_receivers_` and `directory_receivers_` releases held `LockHandle`s
> while file and directory handles are still alive. When a lock held by an
> evicting BFCache handle is destroyed, `Lock::LockHandleDestroyed()`
> synchronously promotes pending lock requests and runs callbacks on live
> `FileSystemAccessFileHandleImpl` instances. In Incognito mode,
> `DidTakeAccessHandleLock()` -> `DoOpenIncognitoFile()` completes
> synchronously and calls `CreateAccessHandleHost()`, inserting into
> `access_handle_host_receivers_` while it is mid-destruction or after its
> backing buffer has already been freed.
>
> Fix this by:
> 1. Declaring `file_receivers_` and `directory_receivers_` after
>    `writer_receivers_` and `access_handle_host_receivers_` and explicitly
>    clearing them first in `~FileSystemAccessManagerImpl()`, after
>    invalidating `weak_factory_`.
> 2. Guarding `TakeLock()` callbacks with `weak_factory_.GetWeakPtr()` so
>    any lock promotion during manager teardown passes `nullptr`.
> 3. Moving elements out of `writer_receivers_` and
>    `access_handle_host_receivers_` before erasing them during teardown
>    and in `RemoveFileWriter()`.
>
> TAG=agy
> CONV=1c519f9c-078d-4200-8484-614956cd3f7d
>

reviewCandidates.subject: [M157] Fix SoftwareImageDecodeCache UAF
reviewCandidates.message:
[M157] Fix SoftwareImageDecodeCache UAF

Original change's description:
> Fix SoftwareImageDecodeCache UAF
>
> SoftwareImageDecodeCache had a bug where if image decode tasks were
> stopped and restarted there could be a collision on
> ImageDecodeRequestId. If the CompositorFrameSink is lost the
> ImageDecodeCache object is recreated and
> ImageController::SetImageDecodeCache() runs. That calls
> StopWorkerTasks() which cancels pending decode requests but didn't
> cancel posted tasks. GenerateTasksForOrphanedRequests() then schedules
> new tasks reusing the same ImageDecodeRequestId range. If a posted
> ImageDecodeCompleted() from before StopWorkerTasks() runs and the
> ImageDecodeRequestId matches one of the new request there is a
> collision.
>
> The collision can result in a CacheEntry being deleted while there is
> still a pending request for it. Avoid collisions by cancelling all
> posted ImageDecocdeComplete() tasks in StopWorkTasks().
>

reviewCandidates.subject: [M157] Detach WebViewPlugin delegate in PluginPlaceholderBase::OnDestruct
reviewCandidates.message:
[M157] Detach WebViewPlugin delegate in PluginPlaceholderBase::OnDestruct

Original change's description:
> Detach WebViewPlugin delegate in PluginPlaceholderBase::OnDestruct
>
> When a RenderFrame is destroyed, PluginPlaceholder subclasses release
> their self-reference and are destroyed. However, the associated
> WebViewPlugin can outlive the RenderFrame if its WebPluginContainerImpl
> is kept alive, for example by script across a layout tree reattach.
>
> To prevent use-after-free issues from WebViewPlugin queued tasks or
> Destroy() accessing a destroyed delegate, this adds
> WebViewPlugin::DetachDelegate() and calls it during
> PluginPlaceholderBase::OnDestruct(). Subclasses are also updated to
> properly invoke the base class OnDestruct().
>
> BUG=573981230

reviewCandidates.subject: [M157] Prevent cross-frame selection on GestureLongPress
reviewCandidates.message:
[M157] Prevent cross-frame selection on GestureLongPress

Original change's description:
> Prevent cross-frame selection on GestureLongPress
>
> When an event handler for `gesturelongpress` mutates the DOM (e.g.
> removing an overlay element above an `<iframe>`), the subsequent hit
> test in GestureManager::HandleGestureLongPress() could descend into a
> child frame and set a cross-document selection on the parent frame's
> FrameSelection.
>
> * gesture_manager.cc: Use event_handling_util::HitTestResultInFrame()
>   instead of EventHandler::HitTestResultAtLocation() in
>   GestureManager::HandleGestureLongPress() so the re-hit-test stays
>   within the handling frame and does not descend into child frames.
>   This is the main fix of the issue.
>
> * web_view_test.cc: Update WebViewTest.LongPressLink to long-press at
>   (499, 299) on the link inside the 500x300 viewport instead of
>   out-of-bounds at (500, 300). This test worked by accident because
>   HitTestResultAtLocation() doesn't have viewport bounds check.
>
> * selection_controller.cc: Verify in `SelectionController::
>   UpdateSelectionForMouseDownDispatchingSelectStart()` that
>   `target_node` and `selection` belong to GetDocument() before and
>   after dispatching `selectstart`, matching
>   UpdateSelectionForMouseDrag().
>   This is an optional change for defence-in-depth.
>
> * selection_template.cc: Upgrade DCHECK_EQ() to CHECK_EQ() in
>   SelectionTemplate::AssertValidFor() to prevent setting a selection
>   whose document does not match the FrameSelection's document.
>   This is another optional change for defence-in-depth.
>
